💡 The novelty lies in using site-selective fluorination of cyclic ketals to tune weakly competing solvation and interfacial electronic response in a single electrolyte platform. item.title: An Amorphous Phosphate-Based Chloride Electrolyte for Low-Stacking-Pressure All-Solid-State Sodium Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت جامد کلریدی بی‌شکل و تغییرشکل‌پذیر Na3Zr2Si1.6PO4Cl14.4 با رسانایی یونی بالا ساخته شد و باتری تمام‌جامد سدیمی را در فشار انباشت پایین پایدار کرد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a chlorination-tailored strategy using SiCl4 to convert rigid [PO4] units into flexible [POxCl4–x] motifs, creating a low-cost, deformable amorphous phosphate-based chloride solid electrolyte. Its significance is enabling high Na+ conductivity (2.02 mS cm–1), low modulus (1.8 GPa), and stable interfacial contact, allowing 4.5 V all-solid-state sodium batteries to cycle over 2000 times at only 5 MPa stack pressure.
🏷 solid electrolyte · sodium battery · chloride electrolyte · amorphous phosphate · stack pressure

item.title: A Semi-single-crystal Architecture Bridging Polycrystalline and Single-Crystal NCM Cathodes
item.description:
معماری نیمه‌تک‌بلور NCM622 با ذرات اولیه بزرگ‌تر در چارچوب ثانویه، ترک‌خوردگی بین‌دانه‌ای را مهار کرده و پایداری چرخه‌ای را بدون افت چگالی الکترود بهبود می‌دهد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a semi-single-crystal NCM622 architecture combining ~2 μm single-crystalline primary particles within a conventional ~6–7 μm secondary-particle framework. This bridges the trade-off between polycrystalline and single-crystal cathodes, preserving high electrode density and rate capability while suppressing intergranular cracking and improving cycling stability—without the aggressive pulverization required for conventional single-crystal cathodes.
🏷 NCM cathode · semi-single-crystal · intergranular cracking · lithium-ion battery · cycling stability
